candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement crediting msg.value to the caller's balance in Put, so Acc[msg.sender].balance no longer increases after a Put call.
Replace the balance addition with a subtraction, so a Put call decreases rather than increases the recorded balance.
Set unlockTime directly to _unlockTime without the timestamp guard, so a past _unlockTime is stored instead of block.timestamp, observable via Acc(msg.sender).unlockTime.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call in Put, so no 'Put' entry is appended to Log.History after a Put call.
Remove the statement that decrements the sender's balance after a successful withdrawal, so Collect never reduces acc.balance.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call after a successful Collect so the log history is not updated on withdrawal.
Remove the `locked_ = true;` statement so the nonReentrant_ guard no longer locks, enabling reentrancy that changes Collect-observable state after reentrant calls.
Remove the `locked_ = false;` statement so the lock stays set permanently after the first guarded call, making all subsequent Collect/Put calls revert.
